beats.say: In twenty twenty one, one stuck ship held up nearly ten billion dollars of trade every single day.
beats.title: ONE SHIP. $9.6 BILLION A DAY.

beats.say: This is the Suez Canal, a hundred ninety three kilometers of water through Egypt.
It connects the Mediterranean to the Red Sea, the shortcut between Europe and Asia.
Without it, ships go all the way around Africa. That adds around ten days to the trip.
Around twelve percent of world trade passes through Suez.
So when the Ever Given turned sideways for six days, shops around the world felt it.
A hundred ninety three kilometers the world can't live without. Follow for more.
beats.title: 193 KM THE WORLD NEEDS
